title: What Do Rationales Communicate? A Message-Intervention Study in Role-Specialized QA
abstract: arXiv:2610.00018v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Role-specialized QA pipelines increasingly pass rationales from a reasoner to a verifier, but it is unclear what this message actually buys: better answers, stronger support assessment, or a new failure surface. We introduce a message-intervention diagnostic that fixes the evidence and candidate answer while varying only the rationale passed across the reasoner-to-verifier boundary. On 400 MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultiHopQA examples with DeepSeek as generator and verifier, faithful rationales add almost no answer accuracy over no rationale, while corrupted rationales strongly alter support judgments. Under a blind verifier prompt, harmless paraphrases shift support by only 0--2.5%, whereas corrupted rationales shift support by 10--22%; an explicit rationale-checking prompt amplifies the same pattern to 34--55%. Final answers move less (2--30%), and only 2.9--35.3% of corrupted support flips co-occur with answer changes. Human audits

translated_title: 推理依据传递了什么信息？角色专业化问答中的消息干预研究
translated_abstract: 角色专业化的问答流水线日益将推理依据从推理器传递给验证器，但这条消息究竟能带来什么尚不清楚：是更好的答案、更强的支持性评估，还是一个全新的失败面。我们引入了一种消息干预诊断方法，在固定证据和候选答案的同时，仅改变跨越推理器到验证器边界的推理依据。在400个MuSiQue、HotpotQA和2WikiMultiHopQA示例上，以DeepSeek作为生成器和验证器，忠实的推理依据相比没有推理依据几乎不提升答案准确率，而被篡改的推理依据则会强烈改变支持性判断。在盲验证器提示下，无害的改述仅使支持性判断偏移0–2.5%，而被篡改的推理依据使支持性判断偏移10–22%；明确的推理依据检查提示将同一模式放大至34–55%。最终答案的变化较小（2–30%），且只有2.9–35.3%的被篡改支持性翻转与答案变化同时发生。人工审计
tldr: 该研究提出一种消息干预诊断方法，发现在角色专业化问答系统中，推理器传递给验证器的推理依据对最终答案准确率几乎没有贡献，但被篡改的推理依据会强烈歪曲验证器的支持性判断，揭示了推理器-验证器通信中的一个新失败面。
en_tdlr: This study introduces a message-intervention diagnostic showing that rationales passed from a reasoner to a verifier add almost no answer accuracy in role-specialized QA, yet corrupted rationales strongly distort the verifier's support judgments, revealing a new failure surface in reasoner-verifier communication.
